tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250bla ma nor lha'i skong ba tshe g.yang dngos grub 'khyil ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 1$0000300hūm̐ hrīḥ bsod nams yongs rdzogs sbyin pa'i phar phyin las// bsod nams 'dod dgu'i dngos grub char 'beb pa'i// bsod nams stobs kyi 'dod 'jo'i bum pa bzang*// mi zad 'dod par 'jo ba'i dga' ston gyis// rtsa gsum nor lha rab 'byams thugs dam bskang*// rigs 'dus padma sambha'i thugs dam bskang*// gu ru skyes mchog tshul bzang thugs dam bskang*// 'gyur med sku yi nor bdag thugs dam= yon tan 'dod dgu'i nor bdag thugs dam= 'gag med gsung gi nor bdag thugs dam= lhun grub phrin las nor bdag thugs dam= steng phyogs lha yi nor bdag thugs dam= bar phyogs mi yi nor bdag thugs dam= 'og phyogs klu yi nor bdag thugs dam= byang phyogs gnod sbyin nor bdag thugs dam= gser dngul nor dbyig nor bdag thugs dam= cang shes rta yi nor bdag thugs dam= zas gos bcud kyi nor bdag thugs dam= rkang bzhi phyugs kyi nor bdag thugs dam= sgo srung rgyal chen sde bzhi'i thugs dam= kun 'khyil lha mo mched gsum thugs dam= zhing skyong sman btsun lha lnga'i thugs dam= gter srung kha rag khyung btsun thugs dam= bka' sdod dregs pa sde lnga'i thugs dam= myur mdzad spu gri ging lnga'i thugs dam bskang*// thugs dam dbyings su bskang ngo byin gyis rlobs// thugs dam gnyan po skong ba'i dam rdzas ni// bkra shis rdzas rtags rgyal srid rin chen bdun// rtsa brgyad stong sbyar chags med rakta'i mtsho// snang srid snod bcud rnam dag bha ling ta// thabs dang shes rab dbyer med byang chub sems// rang byung lhun grub mchod pas thugs dam bskang*// rang rgyud dngos por bzung pa mthol lo bshags// gzi brjid sku yi dngos grub lus la stsol// tshangs dbyangs gsung gi dngos grub ngag la stsol// bde stong thugs kyi dngos grub sems la stsol// rig rtsal yon tan rgyas pa'i dngos grub stsol// phrin las dngos grub bkra shis dpal 'bar shog
ces pa lho brang ri phug gi gnas 'dzin pa rnams kyis bskul ngor zhwa dmar gyi chos sgar du 'dul 'dzin ratnas spel ba bkra shis par gyur cig /sarba dā maṅga laṃ/// /
